notes.title: Version 0.3.1 updates
notes.notes:
Contents added:
1. Added a new level "city cry".
2. Three kinds of resources (metal, flammable and wastes) can be collected and used to build equipment and fortifications.
3. Up to 5 up-gradable robots can be built to help fight.
4. Can build automatic machine gun turret, automatic howitzer turret, straw-man with the help of blueprint.
5. The fortifications at each intersection can be rebuilt after being destroyed.
6. Recovery bin at the base can restore the player's HP.
7. Added six zombies and a Boss.
8. A new set of UI is used in the new scenario.
9. Added a Telekinesis to pick up props from a distance.
10. Added the energy shield model with function to push approaching zombies.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/89975c574060866e52a9939e979d0c48a506d846.png[/img]

Optimized contents:
1. Optimized the moving effects..
2. Optimized oil drum explosion effects with more strength.
3.Optimized the animation of zombie walking, being injured and dying ; head being exploded, being blasted, and being hit fly in particular.
4. Optimized the AI of zombies to hit targets with deadliest hate.
5. The store is simplified, easier to operate and clearer to display, but only in the new scene.
6. The backpack is simplified, one-key acquired, but in the new scene.
7. Grenade throwing optimization.
8. Setting bomb optimization.
9. Optimized the energy shield model. 
10. Optimized the hands model.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/30c19c08ae8b7f5d13b70a76f55b2b3d8cd90097.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/aa9b904b504ec3332458e9673386e367495e7da8.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/298d81274b363c9fa7234ae1f5b156f25d68098c.png[/img]

notes.title: Postponement explanation of the new version
notes.notes:
We sincerely apologize for postponing the release of "Survival test : defend to death", which was originally scheduled to launch on November 30!
The new version will be released until December 7th, as our team pursues the perfect experience in the details.
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/496d47b4d97422e5326e9cb399c5f4c77f19d4ef.jpg[/img]

notes.title: NEW VERSION,EXPECT TO LUNCH BEFORE NOVEMBER 30!!!
notes.notes:
[b] Make your robot team[/b]
you can make your robot team,let help defend!!!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/22ce2270c51e3b963b2f4bac0b3cd8d29db4b02e.jpg[/img]

[b] Five quotas are available[/b]
Five quotas are available,but in the last time,you need find more an more resource.
robot isn't invincible, if they were destroyed,you need make new.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/77b96b2555a164dcf14af024f219c9bedab8db0e.jpg[/img]

[b] Update[/b]
Different from UAV,robots need to be update by killing,after update,robots get more HP,more POW,more AGI.Robots highest level 8,will be strong!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/c05654a60e3f39d7a1f025458bd2b526027f8182.jpg[/img]

[b] Robots instruction[/b]
Robots instruction:Follow,Defense,Patrol.
Follow:follow the player and move around the player;
Defense:select fixed position,destroy all zombies that pass through this location;
Patrol:looking for a line,patrol back and forth.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/539e9d3ab8828f5ef1c60a048f8fa276c52e6dd3.jpg[/img]

[b] Robot repair and death[/b]
After the robot was destroyed,become level 0,so to watch a robot,remember to repair.
When you get "Blueprint"(we will tell you in next letter) ,robots explode when they die,destroy the zombies around robots.
When a robot is injured,you can repair it,but repair need money.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943806/6bc71d6784bdd6645bca99cbd0ef158e36e5ff53.jpg[/img]
